FAQItem.Question: What is CityLink Initiatives?
FAQItem.Answer: CityLink Initiatives is a government platform that streamlines citizens' access to local services, announcements, and community events all in one place.

FAQs.Question: How do I report an issue or concern?
FAQs.Answer: Navigate to the Services section and click "Feedback". Fill out the online form and a council representative will get back to you within 3 business days.

FAQItem.Question: Where can I find the waste collection schedule?
FAQItem.Answer: The waste collection schedule is available under Waste Management in the Services section. You can also subscribe to receive email reminders.

FAQItem.Question: How do I book a community event?
FAQItem.Answer: Visit the What's Happening section and click "Book Now" on any event. You'll need a free CityLink account or to log in to complete your booking.

FAQItem.Question: Is this service available 24/7?
FAQItem.Answer: Yes, the CityLink online platform is available around the clock. For phone or in-person support, check our Contact Us page for office hours.
